summary: Package exports an OpenSSL-encrypted opaque blob unrelated to its stated purpose
details: chain-manager@1.0.8 declares itself a 'Theta Data API' documentation monorepo but its main entry (index.js) re-exports the raw contents of apps/docs/app/des.db as a string named 'desKey'. des.db is a ~63KB OpenSSL 'Salted__' encrypted binary with no plaintext use in this package. The package itself performs no decryption, no execution, no network I/O, and has no install lifecycle hooks — importing it only yields a ciphertext string. The mismatch between the advertised documentation purpose and the shipped encrypted payload, together with the ciphertext-as-library-export shape, is consistent with a staging component intended to be paired with a separate loader that decrypts and executes the blob.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
